themes.roundness_hint: Corner radius of cards, buttons and artwork.
themes.zoom_hint: Scales everything in the window. The zoom shortcuts change it too, and it is remembered between launches.
themes.load_font_file_hint: Load a .ttf, .otf or .woff from anywhere on this computer. It joins both dropdowns above.
themes.open_player: Open the player when you press play
themes.open_player_hint: On, playing a song, album or playlist brings up the full player view. Off, it starts playing and leaves you on the page you were browsing.
themes.tabbed_player: Queue and lyrics in the player view
themes.tabbed_player_hint: On, the player view carries them as tabs and the bar's two buttons switch between them. Off, those buttons only ever open the side panels, which stay open over the player view so you can see both at once.
themes.artwork_background_hint: Tint the player view with the playing track's cover, blurred. Off leaves it plain.
themes.artwork_accent_hint: Recolor the app from the playing track's cover: accent, surfaces and borders, fading between tracks. Off keeps the selected theme's own colors.
themes.reset_theme_hint: Drop the color, roundness and font overrides. Keeps the preset.
themes.app_icon_hint: A PNG replaces the icon in the tray, this window and Alt-Tab. Shortcuts, the file manager and the Windows taskbar button keep the installed one.

playback.normalize_volume_hint: Even out how loud tracks play, so a quiet master is not buried by the one after it. Turn it off to hear every track exactly as it was mastered.
playback.autoplay_hint: Continuously play recommended tracks when the queue finishes.
playback.crossfade_hint: Fade the end of each track into the start of the next one. Runs a second audio decoder while tracks overlap, so it uses a little more memory.
playback.crossfade_lt_paused: Paused while you are in a Listen Together room: an overlap of two tracks cannot be kept in sync with everyone else.
playback.crossfade_duration_hint: How long the overlap lasts. Short tracks fade for less, so a fade never starts before the one before it has finished.
playback.prevent_duplicates_hint: Avoid adding songs that are already in the current queue.
playback.sticky_shuffle_hint: Leave off and shuffle applies only to what's playing: opening an album or playlist afterwards plays it in order.
playback.shuffle_whole_queue_hint: Shuffle mixes the songs you added with Add to queue in with the playlist. Leave off and they play after it, in the order you added them. Play next always plays next.
playback.play_history_hint: Remember recently played tracks for personalized recommendations.
playback.music_videos_hint: Show video stream when available instead of audio only.
playback.ambient_light_hint: The player view around a music video glows with the video's colours.
playback.ambient_light_gpu: Below about 1000 points in the PassMark video card benchmark, the player view may stutter while a music video plays.
playback.hide_videos_hint: Only show audio tracks and official releases in search results.
playback.blocked_artists_hint: Blocked artists are left out of radio, autoplay and recommendations. Playlists and albums you open still play everything in them.
playback.blocked_artists_empty: Nobody blocked yet. Use "Block artist" from a track's ⋯ menu.
playback.lastfm_primary_artist_hint: Send only the first credited artist to Last.fm, so your plays land on the real artist page. Names joined with "&" are kept whole.
playback.lastfm_primary_strict_hint: "Future & Metro Boomin" scrobbles as "Future". Duos with "&" in their name get shortened too.
playback.lyrics_sources_hint: Asked from the top down. Synced lyrics from any source beat plain text from one above it, and a source that's turned off is never asked.
playback.lyrics_sources_none: Every source is off, so no lyrics will be found.

hotkeys.action_next_track_hint: Skip to the next song in the queue.
hotkeys.action_prev_track_hint: Return to the previous song in the queue.
hotkeys.action_mute_toggle_hint: Toggle between muted and previous volume.
hotkeys.action_seek_forward_hint: Jump forward 10 seconds in the track.
hotkeys.action_seek_backward_hint: Jump backward 10 seconds in the track.
hotkeys.action_toggle_shuffle_hint: Turn shuffle on or off for the queue.
hotkeys.action_toggle_repeat_hint: Cycle repeat mode: off, all, one.
hotkeys.action_show_app_hint: Bring the LiMusic Forge window to the foreground.

data.clear_cache_hint: Frees up disk space by clearing cached thumbnails and audio chunks.
data.backups_dir_hint: After every playlist sync, each changed playlist is saved here as a JSON file, in the same format PlaylistForge uses.
data.backups_dir_rejected: That folder belongs to PlaylistForge or LiMusic; backups go to the default folder instead.
data.backups_keep_hint: Snapshots kept per playlist, in the app and in the folder. Older ones are deleted after each sync. The app also keeps each playlist's previous snapshot to compare against, even with 1.
data.backups_export_hint: Save the latest snapshot of every playlist that has one now: synced ones, and any forgotten or from before a sign-out whose snapshots are still kept.
data.backups_busy: A playlist sync is running. Try again when it finishes.

downloads.ytdlp_hint_managed: Downloads songs and videos from YouTube. Installed into LiMusic Forge's own folder, and checked against the checksums its release publishes.
downloads.ytdlp_hint_system: Downloads songs and videos from YouTube. On this system LiMusic Forge uses the yt-dlp on your PATH: install and update it with your package manager.
downloads.ffmpeg_hint_managed: Converts to MP3, joins a video to its audio and embeds covers. yt-dlp's own build, checked the same way.
downloads.ffmpeg_hint_system: Converts to MP3, joins a video to its audio and embeds covers. Taken from your PATH.
downloads.err_checksum: The download did not match its published checksum and was thrown away. Try again later.
downloads.err_busy: Another install is running. Try again when it finishes.
downloads.err_not_managed: On this system the tools come from your PATH.
downloads.err_broken: It was installed but does not run. An antivirus may have quarantined it.
downloads.dir_hint: Every download lands here, named after the title with the video id in brackets, so a file you move into a subfolder is still found.
downloads.format_hint: What Download gets when you don't pick one.
downloads.audio_quality_hint: Original keeps YouTube's own audio (Opus or M4A) as it is. MP3 converts it, for players and car stereos that read nothing else.
downloads.thumbnail_hint: Inside the file shows it in music players; beside it saves the image next to the file.
downloads.cookies_hint: Downloads with your signed-in session, which can unlock the better audio YouTube Premium serves. The cookies go to yt-dlp in a temporary file that is deleted when the download ends.
downloads.channel_hint: Nightly builds carry YouTube fixes days before a release does. Used the next time you install or update.

discord.enable_hint: Show the currently playing song on your Discord profile.
discord.off_notice: Rich Presence is off, so this is not on your profile. The preview still follows your changes.

discord.hide_details_hint: Say only that music is playing. No title, artist, album, artwork, progress bar or buttons leave your machine.

about.boidu: The Better Lyrics database. Word by word, for songs someone has looked up before.
about.lyricsplus: Apple Music lyrics, word by word, with Apple's own romanization.
about.lrclib: Open library of synced lyrics. The widest coverage.
about.youtube: YouTube Music's own lyrics, where they're licensed.
about.simpmusic: Community lyrics matched to the exact YouTube upload, intros included.
about.netease: Large Chinese catalogue. Adds Chinese translations under many songs.
about.qq: Chinese catalogue, strong on Mandopop and Cantopop.
about.kugou: Chinese catalogue, for the rarer tracks.

import.title: Import from Spotify
import.experimental_tooltip: New and still being fine-tuned. If an import gets something wrong, please report it.
import.desc: Bring your playlists over. It all runs on this computer: Spotify is only asked for the playlist, YouTube Music only for the songs.
import.link_desc: Any public playlist or album. In Spotify, open its ⋯ menu, then Share, then Copy link.
import.data_desc: Everything, private playlists and Liked Songs included. Ask Spotify for your account data and it arrives by email, usually within a few days.
import.drop_hint: When the email arrives, drop the zip here. CSV files from Exportify, TuneMyMusic or Soundiiz work too.
import.truncated: Spotify only shared the first 100 songs of this playlist. To bring all of it, use your Spotify data.
import.keep_browsing_hint: You can close this, it keeps going. The sidebar shows how far along it is.
import.pace_hint: LiMusic Forge goes slowly on purpose, about one song every two seconds, so YouTube Music sees ordinary use.
import.waiting: Taking a break to stay well within YouTube Music’s limits. It carries on at {time}.
import.review_desc: {matched} of {total} songs matched. Every pick below is already filled in, so you can create right away or change any of them first.
import.many_lists: {count} playlists will be created, each with its Spotify name.
import.device_only: Signed out, the playlists are kept on this device.
import.failed_hint: Songs found so far are remembered, so trying again picks up where this left off.
import.cancelled_desc: Songs found so far are remembered, so a new import picks up where this one left off.
import.toast_review: Your Spotify import is ready. Open it from the sidebar to finish.
import.toast_done: Your Spotify playlists are in your library.
import.update_tooltip: Add what’s new in the Spotify playlist and take out what left it
import.update_none: Already up to date with Spotify
import.nudge_desc: Bring your playlists and Liked Songs over in a few clicks.

errors.not_spotify: That isn’t a Spotify playlist or album link.
errors.private: That playlist is private, so it can’t be imported from a link. Request your Spotify data below to bring it over.
errors.not_a_list: That links a song or an artist. Paste a playlist or an album.
errors.empty: There are no songs in that.
errors.unreadable: That file couldn’t be read. Use the zip Spotify emailed you, one of the JSON files inside it, or a CSV.
errors.csv_columns: That CSV has no column of song titles.
errors.spotify_changed: Spotify changed how it shares playlists. A LiMusic Forge update will fix this.
errors.not_found: Couldn’t find that on YouTube Music.
errors.cooldown: YouTube Music asked LiMusic Forge to slow down, so imports are paused until {time}. Everything found so far is saved.

import.title: We found data from {sources}. Import it?
import.body: You can bring in your accounts, settings and library now, or later from Settings ▸ Import & migrate.
